$comment: Basemap catalogue. Mapbox GL JS consumes these mapbox:// style URLs natively, so there is no tile template and no raster workaround: the style is passed straight to the map. The token is supplied at runtime, never committed: set VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN in .env, or mapboxToken in public/runtime-config.js for a deployment. Mapbox GL cannot draw anything without a token, so the portal says so plainly rather than showing an empty map.

projections.label: Mercator
projections.$comment: Web Mercator, the default. Correct for tiles and for anything measured in tile space.

projections.label: Globe
projections.$comment: Mapbox globe projection. Honest at national scale and up, and the reason the north reset control exists.
